[DAY6 16:51:01 - DAY6 16:51:30]
I record the event, capturing Alice's puppy and Lucia's puppy together. Shure says, "His name is Er Gou." Alice says, "Lucia's CP dog." Tasha says, "When he gets three, I'll give you one." I smile and pick up a puppy from the ground. Tasha says, "I'll take two." Lucia says, "Suddenly hits people." Tasha asks, "How about that?" I look at the puppy I just auctioned from Lucia. Alice says, "Everyone can call him Er Ha." I watch Alice introduce the puppy's name and everyone laughs. Alice says, "Ah, actually I had prepared some narcissus seeds." I put the puppy down on the ground. Alice says, "But I edited the photo too hard." Alice says, "I forgot to buy them." I watch everyone listen attentively as Alice describes making the puppy: she says, "So I made a paper dog instead," and "And this paper dog comes with a roll of toilet paper." She adds, "The flower I made is already pinned to its ear," while Lucia eats and listens.

[DAY6 16:51:00 - DAY6 16:54:00]
I document Alice holding her puppy and introducing it as "Er Ha," while noting my own preparation of narcissus seeds that I forgot to buy, leading me to create a paper dog adorned with a paper flower pinned to its ear and accompanied by a roll of toilet paper. I check the photos I took as Alice announces the start of the auction with a starting bid of one, emphasizing that bidding need not be high since she can make more. I actively participate by stepping back and forth and raising my hand as the bidding begins.

During the auction, Shure calls out bids, initially at one, with others suggesting stopping, but the bidding continues with references to the paper dog's flower count compared to others. Tasha encourages higher bids, and the bidding reaches two, despite my questioning where the money is coming from. Laughter and playful comments arise as Alice ultimately gives the puppy to a girl who pays with a banknote. Some participants drop out, and Shure attempts to reset the bidding at one, with Katrina suggesting selling at the starting bid. Alice and Tasha discuss repayment and buying more, while Nicous and others engage in casual interactions. I observe the group, noting their positions and expressions as the auction atmosphere continues.

A new participant announces their intent to sell items, prompting questions about their arrival time. I turn to watch Nicous as he moves to the front, smiling, while Shure inspects a computer on the table. Nicous organizes items in his hands, and I photograph him to record the auction. Nicous introduces a bag of seeds, explaining their origin and intended use, with others mentioning purchasing on behalf of others. I suggest considering thematic changes, leading to a group discussion about promoting the seeds as eco-friendly handmade bookmarks. I explain how to plant them and highlight their benefits, then review my photos while listening to the group's talk about watering, sunlight, and the value of sunflowers.

I notice Shure debugging the computer and move into the living room, leaning against the door frame to watch Nicous continue sorting and presenting seeds. My laptop remains on the stairs to the left. The room fills with laughter and applause as Shure, holding a microphone, reminds everyone of regulations from the Market Supervision Administration, inquiring about the total number of items, which is confirmed as six. Shure discusses packaging the seeds two per pack and emphasizes the importance of avoiding isolated sales. Everyone listens attentively as Nicous considers setting the starting bid price, maintaining the auction's orderly progression.

[DAY5 11:35:01 - DAY5 11:35:30]
I stand by the table and talk with Alice. "Hahaha," I laugh. "Not yet," I say. I walk again, reach the bedroom door, and enter the bedroom. Alice: But actually, it's not completely finished. I look around and walk out of the bedroom. "What's still missing?" I ask. I continue into the living room. Alice: Cutting this is really hard on the hands. I look at the puppy Alice made. Alice holds up an object and smiles at me. Alice: Haha. I walk to the side. "This train," I say. "Little dog train," I add. Alice: Train dog. I walk forward. Alice: I want to put a big flower on my dog. I look at the items on the bookshelf and pick up an item. "Model dog," I say.
